# Character trial UI fixtures

Nine user-supplied 2560×1440 screenshots from 2026-09-10, resized to 2048×1152.
Only relevant UI regions are retained on a black canvas; the bottom game identity
and top performance overlay are excluded. These are offline OCR/geometry inputs,
not evidence of automated gameplay. Scaled variants test geometry, not native
rendering at other resolutions. Full six-character scrolling still needs manual
game validation; overlap tests use explicitly synthetic portrait sequences.
